about_the_game:
Abominations came to invade your town. But what are they? No, it can't be... Space gopniks!

Padla, The Break Through is one of the "games within the game", playable in the full version of Dissolved - Chapter One. The superheroine created by the mind of our disturbed protagonist, has taken her katana out of its sheath to go slash what she perceives as a threat coming from space.

The gameplay is a mix of puzzle and action. Gopniks shoot projectiles at you, and you'll need to channel this energy by rushing through them and reach all the enemies in a single sequence of strikes. If you touch the ground, they'll come back. So observe the patterns and plan your attacks carefully!

The demo adds some content compared to the corresponding levels in Dissolved, mainly new silly jokes and the ability select which wave of enemies to play.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: 2.0GHz or more, 32-bit
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI Radeon X1300 / Nvidia GeForce 6600 GT / Intel HD 3000 or better
  • Storage: 33 MB available space

short_description: Pixelated action-puzzle game with a twist: What if you're unable to shoot back, but instead can slash through projectiles to reach your enemies? A simple yet original gameplay, with a tiny bit of silly humor. Don't let gopniks take over the town, with their sportswear and rap music!
